svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rod 12 mm, 182 long; clamp grips the boom 70 inboard of each motor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clamp: 30 long, 36 wide, split under the boom; two M3 bolts close it; 12 bore 20 deep for the rod.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fairing: elliptical 32 x 16, printed hollow, slides over the rod with its long axis fore and aft.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Foot: 36 round, 10 thick, with a 20 deep socket for the rod; print in TPU.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Glue the rod into the clamp and foot with epoxy; all four feet must touch a flat floor.
